name: Three Parallel Rivers of Yunnan Protected Areas
description: In the mountainous north-west of Yunnan, three of Asia's great rivers, the Yangtze (Jinsha), Mekong and Salween, squeeze side by side through deep gorges, some as much as 3,000 metres deep. Glaciated peaks above 6,000 metres tower over them. This 1.7-million-hectare network of eight protected clusters is also one of the richest temperate regions on Earth for wildlife and plants.
